messages:
incident-bot: Pager: KV-cache continuous-batching regression detected in qwen-mqa: sustained prefix-cardinality growth + OOMs on inference nodes in eu-west-1. Alert: high-memory-evictions, increased latency > 95th pctl. Auto-page to #incidents.
Maya P: oncall here, ACKing. pulling dashboards now. any customer-facing pages yet? :eyes:
Raj K: seeing KV > 70% growth over 30m for qwen-mqa. cont-batch window spiked from 20ms->200ms due to backlog. lots of small prefixes hitting cache expansion paths.
Samir V: grabbing logs from pods. run: `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=runtime-qwen-mqa --tail 200` — looks like repeated `kv_store.Put` for new keys.
Maya P: ok, looks like prefetch + continuous batching threshold misfire. prefetched keys are high-cardinality from a single customer pattern (dynamic product ids). starting mitigation plan: 1) throttle prefetch for qwen-mqa, 2) reduce cont-batch window, 3) if not stable, fallback traffic to qwen-small. rolling changes one region at a time.
Raj K: agree. recommend immediate hotfix: set `batch.max_window_ms` 200->25 for qwen-mqa and disable `kv.prefetch.enabled` for model tag `qwen-mqa-hotpath`. low risk.
Samir V: prepared hotpatch. config diff:
```
- model: qwen-mqa
- batch:
-   max_window_ms: 200
- kv:
-   prefetch:
-     enabled: true
+ model: qwen-mqa
+ batch:
+   max_window_ms: 25
+ kv:
+   prefetch:
+     enabled: false
```
Samir V: applying to staging for quick smoke: `infractl apply --env staging --file qwen-hotpatch.yaml`
deploy-bot: deploy queued: qwen-mqa-hotpatch -> staging. CI checks: ok. Rolling to 3 pods.
Maya P: staging looks good, memory drop ~40% on staging pods. latency stable. rolling to eu-west-1 canary (10%).
Raj K: monitoring metrics: mem usage on canary nodes dropping, kv put rate normalized. but still seeing high tail latency on some legacy nodes -> those are older hw (nv4) with smaller cache config.
Kai Z: can we also reduce `kv.max_keys_per_prefix` for qwen-mqa to limit explosion? proposing from 5k->500 for hotpath.
Maya P: yes do that as a follow-on. Samir, include that in next patch if canary stays green.
Samir V: applying canary -> `infractl rollout qwen-mqa --region eu-west-1 --pct 10 --with qwen-hotpatch.yaml` — started.
incident-bot: Incident timeline: threshold trigger 3387649800, page sent 3387654321.
Lia H: I'm taking handoff at 3387654800 (in 10m). can you summarize current runbook actions and customer impact? I'll be primary after handoff.
Maya P: summary for handoff -> mitigation applied: prefetch disabled + max_window_ms reduced on qwen-mqa canary. Observed mem usage down 35% on canary, put-rate down 70%. No customer 5xxs observed so far, increased latency in 95th reduced back to baseline. we saw 1 customer (acct: ACCT-834) with bursts; ops contacted them to throttle heavy prefix generator.
Raj K: customer-impact: transient elevated latency for ~15-45m across small % of requests. no SLA breaches reported yet. we notified CS for ACCT-834 and opened ticket.
Maya P: canary -> green at 3387654680. rolling remaining eu-west-1 at 3387654720, expected finish ~3387655020.
Samir V: full roll started. deploy-bot: rollout 3387654745 -> 100% eu-west-1. Done. post-deploy checks: all pods healthy.
deploy-bot: rollout succeeded: qwen-mqa-hotpatch @ 3387654840.
enginfra: we should also schedule a config-change PR to bump `cache.eviction_threshold` and add guardrails to detect prefix-cardinality spikes. created ticket INFRA-1092.
Raj K: adding temporary rate-limit on prefetch per-customer: `prefetch.rate_per_tenant = 1000/min` — will avoid single-tenant floods.
Maya P: agreed. Lia, handing off now. I'm going offline in 15m but will stay reachable.
Lia H: taking handoff. I'll run 1hr post-mortem monitoring and call out if anything regresses. lia -> oncall bridge if needed. pinging CS and account team for ACCT-834 with summary.
Kai Z: note: related models (mistral variants) have different kv heuristics; we should avoid broad policy changes before model-specific testing.
Maya P: yep, hotpatch limited to qwen-mqa only.
Lia H: current status -> mitigations in place, all eu-west-1 pods healthy, mem stable, kv put rate normal. Marking incident as mitigated. I'll create a short postmortem outline and assign owners.
Raj K: next steps: 1) INFRA-1092 config guardrails, 2) perf test adding synthetic high-cardinality prefixes, 3) per-model prefetch limits, 4) customer-facing postmortem notification draft.
Maya P: thanks team. tagging follow-ups: @enginfra, @sre, @product for evals.
Samir V: logs snapshot + hotpatch diff uploaded to GCS: https://redwood-internal.storage/gcs/incidents/3387654321/qwen-hotpatch.log
Lia H: copying summary into ticket INC-3387654321. closing thread here, will update ticket with postmortem link.
incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. Severity: SEV3 -> tracking.
